printOnDemand.heroTitle: Your idea. Your design. Our production.
printOnDemand.heroLead: Apparel, objects, print, packaging and private label, made in quantity from your designs.
heroPoints: Preview your design on our products
PDF, AI, PSD, JPG and PNG accepted
printOnDemand.productsLead: Apparel, objects, packaging or stationery: pick a product and place your logo or text on it.
printOnDemand.step2Body: A clear quote. Nothing is made without your approval.

faq.a: No. MSLAB only produces in quantity: corporate orders, collections or runs for an event. The minimum quantity depends on the product and technique; it is shown on the product page when defined, otherwise confirmed in your quote.

faq.q: Can you produce under my own brand?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture your collection from your designs, under your label. Mention it in your request, with the products and quantities you have in mind.
Up to 5 files of 15 MB each, in PDF, AI, EPS, PSD, JPG, PNG or TIFF format. A PNG logo with a transparent background gives the best preview.

faq.q: Does the preview match the final result?
faq.a: The preview is indicative. Sizes, colors and the final rendering are confirmed with your quote, before any production.

faq.q: How much does my project cost?
faq.a: Each project is priced according to the product, quantity and finishes you choose. You receive a proposal, and nothing is produced without your approval.

faq.q: Is my design sent when I use the preview?
faq.a: No. The preview runs only in your browser. Your files reach us only when you send your request.

faq.q: How do I track my order?
faq.a: After sending your request, you receive a reference. Enter it on the tracking page to follow your project's progress.
